title: Electron Scattering: A complete PWA of ELSEPA software with GUI
description: Electron Scattering Simulator: an installable Progressive Web App that runs the official ELSEPA Fortran programs (ELSCATA and ELSCATM; F. Salvat, A. Jablonski and C. J. Powell) compiled to WebAssembly, for Dirac partial-wave calculations of elastic electron and positron scattering by atoms, positive ions and molecules. It adds a graphical workbench, energy sweeps, run comparison and experimental-data overlay, and is verified against native ELSEPA by automated parity tests. ELSEPA itself remains under its authors' license.
